Design scope

What the architecture covers

Plan a building that supports learning, supervision and safe movement. Classrooms, circulation, assembly and recreation are balanced around the daily timetable.

01Classroom planningSet room sizes, daylight, acoustics and furniture zones around age and teaching style.
02Safe circulationMake stairs, corridors, entries and exits clear at busy changeover times.
03Assembly spacesPlan halls, courtyards and shared areas around capacity and supervision.
04Recreation and outdoorsConnect play, sports and shaded outdoor spaces to the learning blocks.
05Administration and supportPlace offices, staff rooms, washrooms, stores and services logically.
06Growth and phasingAllow the campus or building to expand without disrupting the core plan.

Eight-step process

From brief to buildable drawings

Each stage closes the important decisions before the next one begins.

01

Brief and site analysis

Confirm the project brief, review the site and record the constraints that shape the design.

02

Concept planning

Test layout, zoning, access and movement before the architectural form is fixed.

03

Form and 3D studies

Develop the exterior character and review key views, proportions and materials.

04

Design development

Resolve dimensions, openings, levels, materials and the key technical decisions.

05

Working drawings

Prepare coordinated plans, sections, elevations and the agreed construction details.

06

Authority submission

Develop the required architectural set around the relevant approval process.

07

Safety and learning systems

Coordinate structure, MEP, fire, accessibility, acoustics and technology requirements.

08

Final handover

Issue the agreed drawing package for pricing, coordination and construction.

Architecture fees

A clear range before the proposal

The fee covers architectural design and drawings. Construction, interior design and fit-out are separate unless they are added to the brief.

IncludedConcept planning, classroom and campus layout, working drawings and coordination.
Final feeThe final proposal reflects student capacity, facilities, site planning, approvals and consultant needs.
Separate costsGovernment charges, surveys and third-party specialist fees are confirmed separately where needed.
Indicative design feePKR 1M–3M

The final proposal reflects student capacity, facilities, site planning, approvals and consultant needs.

Request a proposal

After architecture

Carry the idea into the interior

Woodex Interior Design can develop classrooms and shared spaces after architecture approval. Fit-out remains a separate build scope.
